page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: gâris relata ; ubi etiam nunc inter publica Imperii acta & monumenta servantur. Lous de Cislavicanis expediundum negotium in se denuò recepit, atque ita Frisiâ cum collegâ excessit. Eaque ultima ejus in rebus Frisicis mentio. Senatûs abjectus hac in re animus variè acceptus à posteris, velut haud scitè opportuneque usus aulâ pecuniæ egenâ & cupidâ. Anno deinde M. cccc. lxxxi. qui Loi discessum proximè secutus est, Pacta cum Westergoâ.Octobri mense Westergoi frequentes sedi-tionum ac bellorum civilium formidine in hanc sententiam cum Groninganis pepigère : Nota.Ne Westergoi impedirent eos, si qui sponte sua, sine vi in Ostergoâ vellent se fa-dere[?] jungere cum Groninganis, nec eorum se rebus miscerent : Groningani contra nullos invitos sub foedus suum traherent, aut rebus novis illic studerent : Westergoa etiam rebus abstineren t : ordinibus his sociis injurii non essent : pax coleretur integra & perpetua.
Sed ut unda maris sine fluctu, ita populus exlex & ἀναρχ[?] sine motu & turbis esse non potest. Itaque tumultus minores in Ostergoâ primùm, deinde majo-res

page.notes: Left margin: "Pacta cum Westergoâ." (two lines, the second a hyphenated "Wester-goâ.") and "Nota." beside the italic passage. Small "»" marks stand in the left margin beside "lus exlex" and the line after it; they are not transcribed as text. The Greek word after "&" is worn; the reading ἀναρχ[?] is uncertain. The word "fa-dere" at the line end is uncertain, as is the reading "abstinerent" in the italic passage, which was split across the line. "Loi" is read as printed. The printed "majo-res" is a line-end hyphen; "res" at the foot is the catchword.
